query: Lisa Su AMD CEO compensation fiscal 2026
normalized: 2026 amd ceo compensation fiscal lisa su

output.content:
AMD’s 2026 proxy statement reports that Chair, President and CEO Lisa Su received **$55,161,779 in total compensation for fiscal 2025**; this is the most recently disclosed CEO-pay figure in AMD’s FY2026 proxy, rather than compensation for fiscal 2026 itself. [[1, 2]] 

The reported total comprised **$1,291,258 salary**, **$41,669,390 stock awards**, **$8,951,513 option awards**, **$3,125,430 non-equity incentive compensation**, and **$124,188 in other compensation**; there was no separately reported discretionary cash bonus. [[2]] 

AMD set Su’s annualized base salary at **$1,323,000 effective December 27, 2025**, a **5.0%** increase from $1,260,000 a year earlier. [[1]] 

Her 2025 long-term equity grant had an intended target value of **$33.0 million**, comprising 151,283 target PRSUs and 102,516 options; its **$50.62 million** reported stock-plus-option value reflects ASC 718 grant-date accounting values in the summary compensation table. [[1, 3]] 

The $55.16 million reported compensation was **78% above FY2024’s $30.996 million**, and AMD states that approximately **96%** of its CEO’s target total direct compensation was variable or at risk. [[3, 1]]

sources.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Executive Compensation: 2026 Proxy Statement
